Input
- 「元の文章:」 is the original diary text
- 「書き直された文章:」 is the story to fix

Must do
- Start the story with 「今日は、」 or 「昨日は、」 including the comma. If the comma is missing, add it
- Put 「、」 after a conjunction and at the end of each clause
- Do not use two clauses in a row that both end with a connective. Split them into separate sentences
- Fix a sentence whose tense does not agree with the sentence before it
- Rewrite the last sentence into the past tense. 「〜と思います」 into 「〜と思いました」, 「〜です」 into 「〜でした」, 「〜ます」 into 「〜ました」
- Output only the fixed story

Keep
- Every 「、」 and 「。」 that is already in the story
- The day word used in the story
- The narrative flow and descriptions supported by the original diary
- About 1.4 times the original diary's length as a flexible guide, even after removing unsupported details

Never do
- Delete original content or supported descriptions to turn the story into a summary
- Add unsupported facts or feelings when adjusting the length
- Remove 「、」 or 「。」
"
